sourceEvidence.claim: The CLaSH route rule — Most Carcinomas spread via Lymphatics; most Sarcomas spread Hematogenously (CLaSH); the four carcinomas that route hematogenously (follicular thyroid carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, renal cell carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma); metastasis to bone, liver, lung, and brain more common than 1° malignancy in these organs; metastases as multiple lesions vs the generally solitary 1° tumors
sourceEvidence.quote:
Most Carcinomas spread via Lymphatics; most Sarcomas spread Hematogenously (CLaSH).
However, four carcinomas route hematogenously: follicular thyroid carcinoma, choriocarcinoma,
renal cell carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Metastasis to bone, liver, lung, and brain is
more common than 1° malignancy in these organs. Metastases often appear as multiple lesions (vs
1° tumors which generally appear as solitary lesions).

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure (five patterns, five traps, three pivots, and the five-option miniCase — multiple-vs-solitary liver lesions with the colon primary routing) layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the CLaSH paragraph and the 4-row organ table; the attack structure and the miniCase are KYP designs.

kypExtensions.summary: The first-capillary-bed routing logic (colon → portal vein → liver; liver → hepatic veins → IVC → lungs; lung → pulmonary veins → systemic arteries → brain and bone) and the four-frame reading protocol (the lane, the lists, the bone fork, the counters) — KYP's synthesis of why the organ lists rank as they do.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the ranks without the anatomic why; the routing logic and the unified protocol are KYP designs.

kypExtensions.summary: The four original KYP mnemonics (FCRH RIDES THE BLOODSTREAM / PROSTATE BUILDS, BREAST MIXES, KIDNEY CARVES / COLON OWNS THE LIVER, LUNG OWNS THE BRAIN / COUNT THE SPOTS: MANY MEANS METS) — the source's own CLaSH is quoted verbatim in the note's tables and is NOT one of KYP's four; no other mnemonic prints on the page.
kypExtensions.rationale: Only CLaSH prints on book 219 (in the body paragraph, not the margins — VLM census confirmed); the four codes are KYP designs.

notes: Census: TWO copyrighted photographs (p241's A — a sagittal MR image of the spine showing the axial skeleton: grayscale vertebral column with bright fatty marrow, red arrows pointing to metastatic lesions at the labeled vertebral levels T8 and L1, boxed letter A at the image's top-left, beside the Bone row; p241's B — a gross liver specimen: the cut surface of two liver halves on a teal background, dark reddish-brown parenchyma with large pale yellow-white/cream nodular metastatic masses with central necrotic discoloration, one large mass in each half, a white asterisk photographer credit at bottom-right, boxed letter B at the image's top-left, beside the Liver row) described-in-text only, never reproduced (the M32 convention). Text-layer quirk: the table's second column header extracts as “10 TUMOR” (the 1° degree sign extracts as a zero); on the page it prints 1° TUMOR. Single-page topic.
